restlet.description: Transform a Return Authorization into an Item Receipt from the body of the REST call POST returnAuthorization/{id}/!transform/itemReceipt, with rmaId in the body and each line naming its RMA line by custcol_hc_order_line_id. Answers the receipt's id and whether it already existed by external id. One line of a return receipt batch, or one call. GET answers its OpenAPI file.
restlet.name: HC_RL_CreateItemReceiptFromRma
